mechanism: Tetrabenazine is metabolized by CYP2D6 and medroxyprogesterone may have minor effects on CYP450 metabolism; both drugs can cause CNS depression and tetrabenazine's dopamine antagonism may be potentiated.
action: Monitor for increased tetrabenazine adverse effects (sedation, depression, akathisia) and consider dose adjustment if needed; counsel patient on CNS depression risk.
